name: Frontier Communications
notes: Researched from public frontier.com help center pages only (no sign-in). Frontier ID sign-in uses the email address (registration verifies the email or mobile number with a six-digit code by email or text); passwords need at least 8 characters, a capital letter and a number. Online card/bank payments carry no stated fee (inferred free: the pay page lists fees only for in-person $1.50, and automated phone and mail are free). One-time payments can be scheduled up to 45 days ahead and edited or cancelled from Billing History > Payments. Express Pay (no sign-in) asks for the account number plus email or ZIP code. Auto Pay starts right away unless the bill is due within 24 hours; no discount stated. Cancelling service is by phone at 800-921-8101 (or chat). Payment arrangements are not described on the public pages used, so the family default is kept. Frontier is now owned by Verizon but billing remains on frontier.com.

cancel_service.note: Frontier service cannot be cancelled in the online account. Call 800-921-8101 to cancel.

help.title: How to pay your Frontier bill
paragraphs: Sign in and choose Make a Payment from the My Bills tile, or use the MyFrontier app. You can pick the amount, the date and the payment method, and schedule a one-time payment up to 45 days ahead. Edit or cancel a scheduled payment from Billing History, Payments tab.
Express Pay lets you pay once without signing in: enter your account number plus your email or ZIP code, then your payment details.

The automated line at 800-917-7489 takes bank, debit or credit card payments with no fee; have your 17-digit account number ready. Mailed checks or money orders go to Frontier with the account number on the For line. Paying in person at an authorized retail location costs $1.50 and posts the next business day.

help.title: Manage Auto Pay
paragraphs: Sign in, select Go to My Billing in the My Bills tile, choose Set up Auto Pay, pick a saved or new bank account, debit or credit card, accept the terms and select Enroll.
Automatic payments begin right away unless your current bill is due within 24 hours; in that case pay that bill with Make a Payment.
To change the method, open Auto Pay from Quick links and select the pencil icon. To stop, open Auto Pay from Quick links, choose Turn off Auto Pay and confirm.
steps: Sign in and select Go to My Billing.

help.title: Paperless or printed billing
paragraphs: Sign in, select Go to My Billing, and choose Enroll in Paperless on the tile that shows paperless billing is off, then confirm.
To go back to printed bills, choose Turn off Paperless on the same tile and confirm. In the app, use Billing, then Settings.

help.title: Cancel your Frontier service
paragraphs: Service changes such as Auto Pay, paperless billing and card updates can be made in the online account, but cancelling service is done by calling Frontier at 800-921-8101.

help.title: Create your Frontier ID
paragraphs: Register with the email address or mobile number on your account. Frontier sends a six-digit code by email or text; you then confirm your service address and verify a second contact method. If neither works, choose Try another way and use your last name and service address.
Your password needs at least eight characters, including a capital letter and a number. After that you sign in with your email address and password.
